contentList.content: You gain three Channel Oath Charges per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, which allow you to trigger various effects determined by your choice of subclass.
You gain three Smite Charges per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, which allow you to deal tremendous damage to your enemies.

Selecting this as your starting subclass grants the Oathbreaker dialogue tag, disabling your ability to swear an oath, as well as respec. Toggle this passive off in order to remove the Oathbreaker dialogue tag, allowing you to respec. This can be toggled at any time.

Oaths upheld lend permanence to power, strengthened by your conviction. To what ideals have you sworn yourself to?

Breaking your oath will result in grave consequences.

You've sworn to exert your wisdom, identify the higher morality in any given circumstance, and fight for it. To chasten those who dole out their villainy by wiping their blight from the world forever.
You have sworn to preserve the ideals of civility and law, serving society to ensure it might continue. To always uphold and protect the belief of the civil majority, even when you may not agree.
You have sworn to show kindness, to enkindle the light of hope in the bleakest hollows of despair. To stand against the devilry that would snip its stem, as a beacon of prosperity for all to follow.

You've sworn to show courage in the face of hardship, stride dauntlessly into action, and to lend your arm to those in need. To tend to your responsibilities, and support those entrusted to your care.

Oaths emboldened lay bare the path to preserve one's ideals.
A hammer of dawn to fall upon those deserving.
How many times you may channel the strength of your resolve into a relentless Smite.
Once per turn, upon killing another creature, you immediately restore one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WarPriestActionPoint">Crusader's Smite</LSTag> charge.

Lay waste to your enemies.
Lay bare your conviction.

Smite your target with divine fury. Upon damaging a target, further <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> made against the target are rolled with Advantage as well. This action always rolls with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

Affected creature is unable to utilize <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Actions</LSTag>.

Wardens of life and light, you bind your oath to the quiet strength of nature. Where hope grows stubborn, and darkness is worn away by time, your light shines as a beacon of hope and prosperity.

Once per turn, upon landing a killing blow on a Fey enemy, restore one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WarPriestActionPoint">Crusader's Smite</LSTag> charge.

Heal yourself and all allies within [1] for [2].
Affected creature will automatically cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HealingRadiance">Healing Radiance</LSTag> again when this status expires.

Bound to the endless flame that is your will, you rise unbroken. Each failing serving as a spark, a promise that even in ash, the will of fire shall endure.

You are the serrated edge of justice unyielding, relentless, and cold - vengeance embodied, living in service to those who would cry out for it.

You have broken your sacred Oath in pursuit of power and ambition. Only darkness remains to fuel you now.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Summoner

Use the power of your shattered Oath to exert control over a hostile creature, influencing them to attack their allies.

Fatal Encounters cannot be Subjugated.
Affected creature has had their will bent by an Oathbreaker, influencing it to attack its allies indescriminately.

Targeting a corpse during combat will instead immediately raise a Shadow servant until the end of your current combat encounter. Shadows are considered to be Horde-Based summons.

Shadows are considered to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SUMMONING_SICKNESS">Horde-Based</LSTag> summons.

Upon killing a target, you inflict upon them a terrible curse, shattering their mind into fragments which become trapped within your equipped weapons and cause you to deal an additional [1].
